fields.description: Master switch for the whole marketing module. While off, no connector runs and no scheduled job does any work. Every per-platform flag below is additionally required — this one alone turns nothing on.
fields.label: Enable Marketing Module

fields.description: Pull campaigns and daily metrics from Google Ads. Requires an approved developer token with Basic Access — see docs/marketing-platform-approvals.md.
fields.label: Google Ads

fields.description: Pull campaigns and daily metrics from Meta Ads. Requires the ads_read permission from Meta App Review.
fields.label: Meta Ads

fields.description: Pull campaigns and daily metrics from LinkedIn Ads. Requires Marketing Developer Platform access, historically the slowest approval of the set — if it never clears, LinkedIn spend goes in as offline Marketing Spend rows instead.
fields.label: LinkedIn Ads

fields.description: How many trailing days to re-pull on every run. Platforms revise spend and conversion figures after the fact, so the last complete day is not final. The (campaign, date) key makes a re-pull an upsert rather than a duplicate.
fields.label: Restate Trailing Days

fields.description: How far back to reach on an account's first sync, when it has no cursor yet.
fields.label: Initial Backfill Days

fields.description: Attempts per request before a run is marked Failed. Applies to retryable responses only — 429 and 5xx. A 403 is a configuration fault and is never retried.
fields.label: Max Retries

fields.description: Rows written per commit when ingesting daily metrics.
fields.label: Sync Batch Size

fields.description: How long to keep Marketing Raw Payload rows. The archive is for debugging a mapper against what the platform actually sent; it is not a data store and it grows quickly.
fields.label: Raw Payload Retention (days)

fields.description: Summary of the most recent run. Per-account connection state lives on Ad Account, and the per-run detail is in Marketing Sync Log.
fields.label: Last Sync Status
